svg.text: Every processor model (both pipelines, both microprogrammed CPUs) calls the same ALU class. Division by zero raises DivideByZero.
Carry-lookahead adder: one 4-bit block (8 blocks make 32 bits)
every carry straight from g, p, c0 (2 gate levels)
The carry skips a whole block
at a time instead of one bit.
10 -> product -= A << i (a run of 1s starts)
01 -> product += A << i (a run of 1s ends)
wins on runs of 1s, e.g. negative numbers
shift R left, bring in next dividend bit
R >= 0 ? R = R - D : R = R + D
never 'adds back' -> about half the work
